description: Only Linux packages reach Cachix today and magic-nix-cache depends on the fragile GitHub Actions cache. CI cold start is dominated by Nix realisation; an action-cache hit is useless after 20 min of cell builds. Add aarch64-darwin if a macOS job exists. See docs/research/remote-execution-and-caching.md (commit adc3619d) §5.
title: Push CI shell closure (cells, toolchains cell, prelude) to Cachix (G9)
